'''Emissive Munitions''' is a weapon [[Experimental Effects|Experimental Effect]] that coats a struck target in energetic particles, sharply increasing its detectable heat signature. This makes cold or low-signature ships easier to keep on sensors and track with assisted weapons.

== Effect ==

A successful hit applies the target-signature effect. The weapon receives:

* '''Target signature increased''' on hit
* '''Thermal load:''' +100%

The doubled thermal load applies to the modified weapon and increases the firing ship's heat generation. It does not directly increase the weapon's damage.<ref name="inara-effects">[https://inara.cz/elite/experimentaleffects/ INARA: Experimental effects], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref><ref name="fandom-emissive">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Emissive_Munitions Elite Dangerous Wiki: Emissive Munitions], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref>

== Compatible weapons ==

Emissive Munitions can be installed on:

* [[Pulse Laser|Pulse Lasers]];
* multi-cannons;
* [[Seeker Missile Rack|Seeker Missiles]];
* dumbfire missile racks;
* [[Mine Launcher|Mine Launchers]].

The effect can be installed by an [[Engineers|Engineer]] whose workshop supports Engineering for the receiving weapon. Experimental Effects must be applied at an Engineer workshop and cannot be pinned for [[Remote Engineering]].

== Materials ==

Applying Emissive Munitions requires:

* 3 Manganese
* 4 Mechanical Equipment
* 3 Heat Exchangers
* 3 Unexpected Emission Data

The materials are consumed once when the effect is applied. Replacing it with another Experimental Effect consumes the new effect's materials.

== Tactical use ==

Emissive Munitions is most useful against ships that depend on a low heat signature, heat sinks, or Silent Running to reduce sensor detection. Keeping the effect active can preserve a usable target signature for gimballed and turreted weapons and make follow-up fire easier to place.

A combat loadout normally needs the effect on only one suitable weapon because the signature increase does not multiply when several Emissive weapons hit the same target.<ref name="pve-weapons">[https://sites.google.com/view/ed-pve-combat/outfitting/weapons E:D PvE Combat Wiki: Weapons], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref> A Pulse Laser or multi-cannon offers repeated opportunities to refresh the effect, while a missile or mine applies it less continuously.

The main cost is heat. The modified weapon can make a hot-running build harder to manage, especially during sustained fire. If the target-signature utility is not needed, a direct damage or efficiency effect may provide more value.
